WoW: Forever

Feral — Cat Druid

Energy and combo points in Cat Form, on bleeds rather than big hits. From level 20 onward, one guide calls it "one of the fastest and most mobile specializations in the WoW Forever beta." Before 20 you are a bear.

WoW: Forever · Melee DPS · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. Bear and Cat share one talent tree and mostly one build. They have separate pages because the rotations, stat priorities and gear are completely different. No source had posted a level 30 build when this page was written. The level 30 line below is built on the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4. If a tooltip on this page differs from the text, go by the text.

What Cat is for

Damage out of stealth, at speed, and on bleeds that keep ticking while you reposition. Feral SwiftnessFeral SwiftnessTalentCastInstantIncreases your movement speed while in Cat Form by 30%, and increases your chance to Dodge by 4%. gives "a permanent 30% speed buff while in Cat Form" plus +4% dodge in all forms, and it now works indoors. You also have ProwlProwlLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled., shapeshifting breaks roots, and RipRipLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost30 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration12 secFinishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 44 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 71 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 97 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 124 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 150 damage over 12 sec. scales with attack power and runs 12 seconds off five combo points.

The published verdict measures solo kill speed, and it applies only from 20, when Cat Form arrives. One guide's "fastest and most mobile" line describes a cat that already has its form.

Cat Form now comes from a quest chain rather than a trainer. "In WoW Forever, druids earn Cat Form with a quest chain at level 20. Your trainer sends you to Moonglade, the Great Cat Spirit asks for three relics hidden in the Stormrage Barrow Dens, and when you bring them back your trainer teaches you Cat Form, ProwlProwlLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the Druid to prowl around, but reduces your movement speed by 40%. Lasts until cancelled., ClawClawLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeClaw the enemy for 110% normal damage plus 27. Awards 1 combo point. and RipRipLevel 20 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost30 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration12 secFinishing move that causes damage over time. Damage increases per combo point and by your Attack Power: 1 point : 44 damage over 12 sec. 2 points: 71 damage over 12 sec. 3 points: 97 damage over 12 sec. 4 points: 124 damage over 12 sec. 5 points: 150 damage over 12 sec. in one go." It is 2,885 experience in total, and the relics are party loot: "Five druids in a group loot the relic once instead of five times."

Stat priority

Agility first, then Strength, then Stamina.

The reason Agility leads is that "in cat form it is attack power, critical strike and armor at once."

Your weapon's damage now counts in Cat Form, which reverses a Classic habit. Cat Form's flat attack power is 12 plus Agility, against Classic's 40, and abilities gained weapon-damage terms. Blizzard's framing: auto-attack DPS in Cat Form equals your weapon's DPS, at a fixed 1.0-second swing speed, 2.5 seconds in Bear or Dire Bear Form. Weapon-damage abilities use the same numbers. Blizzard publishes the two speeds but not which form takes which, so that pairing is ours, not a source's. The result: "the weapon here is chosen on its damage first, then on its stats." Published level-20 cat weapon picks are two-handers on both factions, held in both hands.

One source disputes the weapon-DPS priority outright. Three sources and the client data are against it, but the disagreement exists and no source publishes the actual conversion formula.

What Forever changed for Cat

  • The old FurorFurorTalentCastInstantGives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 20% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 20 Energy. powershifting trick is dead, and Blizzard reintroduced the gameplay in a different form on purpose. FurorFurorTalentCastInstantGives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 20% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 20 Energy., now in Feral tier 1, was rewritten: instead of a flat 40 energy on entering Cat Form, five points let you regenerate Energy out of form "as if they were in Cat Form". Energy you hold is kept through Bear and Dire Bear Form, but it does not regenerate in them. The numbers are client text rather than published. At 5/5, shifting into Cat Form restores 100% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 10 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 100 Energy, and "Leaving an empty bar and instantly re-entering supplies no flat refill." Blizzard then adds: "We realize this removed the 'power shifting' gameplay some players prize, so we have re-added that gameplay in a much more approachable way with the Shifting PowerShifting PowerTalentCastInstantCost55% of base ManaCooldown16 sec cooldown talent in the Feral talent tree."
